remarks: Come see this completely updated modern loft featuring soaring windows with 16' ceilings, private bedroom with walk in closet and hallway closet, updated full bath with Kohler and Moen fixtures and quartz vanity. Kitchen offers newer stainless steel appliances, and opens to the dining area, living room. The Clocktower Close is a historic building that has been renovated to provide fabulous living space and community areas throughout the premises, including an outdoor courtyard, a full gym and a full locker room w/sauna, a business meeting room, a full community kitchen, a billiards room and a dog run. Easy access to highways, train station and public transportation. Minutes to shopping, new SoNo mall, restaurants, parks and to the beach.
